name: Energy Arc
oracle_text: Untap any number of target creatures. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by those creatures this turn.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by those creatures this turn.

needs.what: a combat-only flag on the prevent_damage_permanent op (e.g. combat_only: true), so the PermanentShield it installs with dealt 'to_and_by' and duration 'this_turn' prevents only combat damage dealt to and by the targeted creatures, letting noncombat damage (burn, fight, pings) through
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage_permanent (objects {target: t1}, dealt to_and_by, this_turn) is the exact shape but its PermanentShield has no combat flag and prevents ALL damage, a strictly better card; the combat_only key exists only on the prevent_damage static, which lives on a printed permanent, is continuous with no 'this turn' clock, cannot be installed by a resolving instant, and only stops damage dealt to what it matches, not by it
